title: sensor issues
symptom: The Libre sensor displays 'lo' even with a normal NFC scan while blood glucose is around 10 according to a BG test, and the sensor has just under 4 days left of use.
cause: The sensor may have moved slightly and stopped measuring, possibly due to the arm holder or strap used with the Blucon.
fix: Replace the sensor and consider fixing it with transparent adhesive (e.g., Fixomull Stretch or Tegaderm) to prevent movement.
evidence_quote: I assume your Sensor moved a bit and doesn't measure anything anymore. you should replace it. make sure your property clean the skin and if it Happens again you should consider fixing the Sensor with kind of transparent adhesive.
